hypothesis: Reusing each BF16 weight tile across 2/4/8 token rows may reduce small-batch projection overhead.
controls: GPU1, OMP4, deterministic random BF16 inputs, actual projection shapes, unchanged FP32 accumulation and BF16 output
stop: Reject any nonfinite output or RRMS >= 0.003; no serving integration without model and audio validation
result: Only selected B2 projections improve; B4 gains are small and B8 is slower. Diagnostic retained; no default changed.
